data.name: Holiday Inn Mexico Dali Airport by IHG
data.address: Viaducto Rio De La Piedad: 260, Magdalena Mixihuca, 15850 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
A 5-minute walk from a metro station, this bright, no-nonsense hotel is 4 km from the presidential office at the National Palace and 5 km from Mexico City International Airport.
The relaxed, straightforward rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and desks. Upgraded rooms provide additional space. Suites include separate living rooms with sofas. Room service is available 24/7.
There's a funky International bar/restaurant, along with an exercise room, a business center and an airport shuttle. Massage treatments are offered for a fee. Parking is available.
